gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Unica One opens its lowercase wide, with a huge eye and daylight inside every curve. Noto Sans Brahmi carries a high mean line and open-ended curves, so running text glides without snagging.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-carian: Distinctive, rounded-nib lettering in Unica One carries a uniform thickness throughout, with no swelling at stroke ends. But shrink it down and that presence fades, while Noto Sans Carian keeps its open terminals and tidy ascender gaps.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Straw-bent lines, huge lowercase eyes: that is Unica One. Noto Sans Chakma packs its lowercase up toward the caps yet leaves the s and c mouths open, so text keeps moving.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-cham: Wire-weight strokes define Unica One, with huge lowercase eyes and plenty of daylight showing inside each curve. Give Noto Sans Cham a modest size; its rounded forms handle the rest.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Noto Sans Coptic is a sans-serif whose middle zone dominates the line, with open, uncrowded mouths on the s and c. Unica One's zero-contrast strokes and huge lowercase eyes lead the page with force.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Unica One draws a skeleton outline at one fixed thickness, with huge lowercase eyes and daylight inside every curve. What stands out is how Noto Sans Elbasan keeps its terminals open.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Identical bar thickness runs across every line of Unica One, with huge lowercase eyes. Noto Sans Georgian, a sans with open curves, can stay modest in size beside it.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Every stroke of Unica One is as stout as a drawn pipe cleaner. It is made to announce, whereas Noto Sans Grantha, a sans with tall little letters, never snags on a closed bowl.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Commanding and free of calligraphic modulation, Unica One earns its keep big and short. Noto Sans Gujarati, a sans-serif with large open counters in tall a, e and s, handles the rest.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-go: Uniform bars, huge lowercase eyes: that's Unica One. Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi brings tall strokes and terminals cut back to leave a big gap, which gives that loud heading room to breathe.
